title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the threshold kinetic energy T_p.

title: Energy Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the energy conservation equation for the reaction.

title: Mass Values
description: Important Criteria: The student must use the correct mass values for the proton and pion in the calculations.

title: Calculation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show clear steps in calculating the total energy required for the reaction.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the energy calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit factors such as the rest mass energy of the particles involved.
